title: Platform: make nested collection cardinality, completeness and ancestor writes safe at depth N
gate: Raised by pp-012's red depth-3 characterisation. This must land and flip all four pp-012 it.fails cases before pp-021 or any m3 commodity page proceeds.
recipe: No recipe exists (SIBLING-SET-PLAN.md §8 G-B). The four it.fails cases in bridge/depth-three-collection.characterisation.test.js are the executable specification; fix the generic L2 engine only, never a commodity page.

filesToTouch.what: Make minEntries/maxEntries cardinality for a nested group evaluate per immediate parent instance rather than once over the global record list. Top-level groups retain the existing single aggregate error. Nested errors carry the parent fulfilment id as instanceId and the count for only that parent; use the group's within implication records as the parent worklist. Preserve anyOfIds, allOrNothingOfIds and recordCountEquals semantics unchanged.

Include nested minEntries/maxEntries cardinality errors when rolling a parent entry's completeness. A lines instance with zero required species must be incomplete even when its own mandatory line leaf is filled. Keep optional empty varieties complete and retain the direct mandatory-leaf check for a positional empty variety.

Validate every numeric ancestor in collectionPath against the current positional answer tree before appendEntryAt/updateEntryAt/removeEntryAt calls setAt. An absent, non-integer or out-of-range parent is rejected without calling replaceJourneyFulfilment: append returns null and update/remove remain no-ops. This prevents sparse fulfilments being saved before projectAnswers throws.

Flip the four pp-012 it.fails contracts to ordinary tests without changing their names or assertions: species minEntries per line, missing species rolling up to line incomplete, and clean rejection at each of the two out-of-range ancestor levels.

Add focused depth-2 regression coverage for per-parent min/max counting, parent completeness rollup and mutation rejection so the generic behavior is pinned below the pp-012 integrated fixture. Do not alter existing assertions, expectations or test names.

specs: The existing pp-012 depth-three characterisation is the acceptance suite; all four it.fails declarations become plain tests with assertions unchanged.
Focused L2 unit cases cover two parents where only one has nested records, nested max counting per parent, and both invalid ancestor levels before persistence.
acceptanceCriteria: groupInvariantErrors(species, state) reports one MIN_ENTRIES error with instanceId line1 when line0 has a species and line1 has none; a sibling's records can no longer satisfy another parent's floor.
Nested maxEntries is counted per immediate parent as well as nested minEntries; top-level min/max output remains byte-compatible.
entryComplete returns false for a line whose required species collection is empty, while an absent optional varieties collection remains complete.

appendEntryAt at ['lines', 5, 'species', 0, 'varieties'] and ['lines', 0, 'species', 9, 'varieties'] returns null, leaves canonical records unchanged and never persists a sparse fulfilment map; update/remove at equivalent invalid parents are no-ops.
All four pp-012 it.fails cases are plain green tests with names and assertions unchanged; no production file under sets/ and no commodity page is edited.
npm test, npm run lint and npm run lint:arch are green; .dependency-cruiser-known-violations.json retains SHA-1 0762285ef5bfdd1f06af6fbea491e5e69b53e19a.
notes: pp-012 proved the failure is generic L2 behavior, not plant-products modeling. The evaluator enumerates depth-3 paths correctly, but checkMinEntries/checkMaxEntries count the whole nested group globally and emit no parent identity. collection-complete only consults per-instance anyOf errors, so it cannot see a nested collection floor. The write path calls setAt before validating either ancestor; replaceJourneyFulfilment persists line5/species0/variety0 or line0/species9/variety0, then projectAnswers rejects the sparse indices, leaving storage already replaced. Fix all three layers together so the test can flip without weakening it. Status derivation already performs a parent-scoped recursive walk and must remain unchanged.
